lines: The lips below the eye mask let a sharp breath escape.
Her kodachi raced along at a speed that not a single armed refugee could follow with their eyes.
Suddenly, one man's head popped off.
It tumbled to the ground with a thump, still wearing a bewildered expression.
Another, different man's head flew off.
The armed refugees couldn't follow Yuri's movements.
It looked as though a faint silhouette was dashing between them, and then their heads were popping off on their own.
Gunshots echoed in the sprawling flood bypass.
Succumbing to fear, the men fired their guns indiscriminately.
However, they were never going to be able to hit Yuri, a former Taimanin and assassin, with something like that.
The most they could do was hit each other by mistake, and collapse.
「Get out of here. If you do, then I'll stop too.」
「Sh-Shuddup! Don't you underestimate us, you whore!!」
The armed refugees made no attempt to flee in the slightest.
She had thought she was going pretty easy on them, but, far from running away as their friends were killed one after another, they were relentlessly pursuing her, driven by a lust for revenge.
（Looks like I killed a little too many of them, huh?）
（I don't want to use my Bewitching Eye to wipe them all out, so I'll just be the one to run away.）
Figuring that she would get nowhere at this rate, Yuri formed a breach in the circle of armed refugees, and began to take flight.
However, the armed refugees of Yomihara weren't so accommodating.
「Shit!! She ran away!! Dogs! Sic the dogs on her!!」
The armed refugees appeared to have released the demonic hounds.
Ferocious barks were chasing after her.
With no other choice, Yuri took down the armed refugees that stood in her way, but far from diminishing, enemies were springing out incessantly.
Their numbers were already in the excess of dozens.
It was an unfavourable number, even for her.
「There's no choice, huh? I'm not that keen on it, but...」
Yuri, who was on the point of being surrounded again, was about to give up and take off her eye mask, when at that moment,
「Oi oi oi oi! You're makin' an awful racket, aren'tcha?」
All of a sudden, one man slowly rose from behind a pillar.
「I can't sleep properly if you're gonna be doin' all this flashy shootin', ya know......? Haaah.」
It appeared that the man had been dozing in the middle of this uproar.
He was making a sleepy expression, and scratching his head, complete with bed hair (or was that his hairstyle from the start?).
「I dunno what's goin' on, but if I hafta pick one side or the other, I'm goin' with the beautiful woman!」
Before she knew it, the strange man had a massive gun at the ready.
She didn't even know when he had pulled it out. It was extremely quick work.
A gigantic mass of energy levelled the encirclement of armed refugees in one blast.
The man held his hand out to Yuri.
「Huh? Aren'tcha gonna run away? Or were you gonna wipe those guys out?」
She began to flee through the escape route that the man had opened.
She didn't take the hand that had been offered.
The strange man shrugged his shoulders, and began to guide Yuri for some reason.
「Those guys aren't gonna chase us this far.」
Under the strange man's guidance, Yuri had finally arrived at a narrow tunnel.
Sure enough, their pursuers weren't coming anymore.
Just as soon as they had entered this shaft, those persistent armed refugees had given up the chase.
Yuri questioned, without relaxing her guard.
True, the man had helped her, but everything about him, from his sudden appearance to all the rest of it, was far too suspicious.
Without seeming to mind, he said, in an overly friendly tone,
「That's 'cuz this place is a nest for huge demonic beasts.」
「Oh, it's all right. I've brought a scent ball that the demonic beasts can't stand. They're not gonna come near us.」
She could clearly discern an odd smell once they entered this narrow shaft.
「Sorry. It's a tip from an old buddy of mine, y'see.」
「He told me, “I was studyin' some books when I found a safe way to pass.”」
「Guess they're right when they say the best thing you can have is a friend. More like a pain-in-the-ass best bud, though.」
「By the way, you can see with that?」
The man pointed at Yuri's blindfold, and casually asked something that didn't normally get asked.
「I can see. But I advise against you taking it off.」
「Huh? I'm not gonna. I wouldn't do somethin' like that.」
「Not my style to do tacky stuff like usin' force to check out what a woman's hiding.」
It looked like he had just wanted to ask. The man shrugged his shoulders exaggeratedly.
「More important. I'm in the middle of headin' to Yomihara too. How about we go together?」
「I'm fine. Thank you very much for saving me. I'll make it on my own from here.」
She said her thanks without letting her guard down, and tried to distance herself from the suspicious man.
「Fine, if you say so. But if you get far away from me, the demonic beasts are gonna show up. See? Over there.」
A humungous earthworm, a full two metres in diameter, slithered into view from a tunnel.
She made an involuntary shriek, and jumped back towards where the man was.
「Oh, nice. I got to hear a cute voice.」
「Th-That's the demonic beast? That big worm?」
She couldn't stand worms. Much less enormous ones like that.
「That one's still on the small side. 'Cuz, y'see, Devil Worms in these parts get fat from eatin' lots of humans.」
「So? Whaddya gonna do? You gonna go with me?」
「And forget asking me to split up the scent ball. That's bein' way too much of a pest. And it's supposed to repel pests! Hahahaha!」
He was making a face which said that he already knew her answer.
She was a tiny bit annoyed, but there was no alternative.
「I take back what I said earlier. Please accompany me to Yomihara. I'll pay you a reward, of course.」
「I provide “safety and guidance”, you provide me a “bodyguard for the journey”. It's give and take.」
If it were just accompanying him to Yomihara, that would be one thing, but was it good to get that involved with a man like this, whose true colours were unclear?
She couldn't help but think that, but his next proposal was the clincher.
「If you got business in Yomihara, it's better to have an ally, right? I'll introduce you to my Boss. She knows Yomihara well.」
「......Understood. I'll take you up on that “give and take”.」
「Awwriiight. It's a deal. Pleasure doin' business with you. I'm Kanzaki Juubei.」
Kanzaki Juubei held out his hand again.
And so it was that she came to set off for Yomihara in the company of this extremely strange man, Kanzaki Juubei.
